name: DCA Aunt Cass Café Soba Noodle Salad with Poached Shrimp (Pick Out Raw Veggies Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Chilled poached shrimp and soft buckwheat-wheat soba noodles are dairy-free and light on a hot afternoon when you eat the shrimp and noodles and leave the raw cabbage/edamame behind.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep the ginger-sesame dressing on the side (use lightly) and eat the poached shrimp and soft soba noodles while pushing aside shredded raw cabbage and edamame.
watchOuts: Skip the raw shredded cabbage, edamame skins, and cilantro
